tasks.title: Package agent integration for Cursor and Claude Code
tasks.description: Add shared swarm skill under .cursor/skills and .claude/skills, bin/swarm wrappers, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointers, and README agent section so Cursor Agent and Claude Code actually invoke evoharness for second-opinion / debate / committee / audit jobs.
tasks.details: Canonical wrappers: swarm (subcommand or --preset), swarm-review (committee), swarm-debate, swarm-audit. Skills auto-trigger on second opinion, committee review, plan critique, adversarial debate — not routine coding. README documents install for both IDEs.
tasks.testStrategy: bin/swarm --help; wrappers resolve evoharness; skill files exist in both IDE paths with matching triggers; README section present.

tasks.title: Harden tool dispatch authorization and dry-run execution
tasks.description: Enforce allowlist check immediately before tool execution in executor.py; preserve explicit --tools none even if spec defines tools; prevent MCP subprocess spawning in dry-run mode

tasks.title: Enforce budget and spend limits in CachedBackend for ReAct completions
tasks.description: Wrap complete_messages() in CachedBackend with budget_usd verification and spent tracking; raise BudgetExceeded on cap hit

tasks.title: Remediate structured key secret leaks and expand JSON redaction
tasks.description: Redact dict values when key matches SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN in _sanitize_audit_args; update inline regexes to scrub quoted JSON key-value pairs; pass context.env to all audit log scrubbers

tasks.title: Implement bounded timeouts, pipe cleanup, and hard byte truncation limits
tasks.description: Add timeout to communicate() after killpg in BashTool; enforce hard byte-level truncation in truncate_output; bound MCP pipe writes and close all 3 pipes on exit

tasks.title: Fix node cache invalidation for mutating tools and scope MCP pool keys
tasks.description: Bypass node_cache when mutating tools are enabled; key MCPProcessPool clients by (server_name, command, args, cwd); preserve file permissions on atomic replace

tasks.title: Fix installed wrapper alias routing and unify release version metadata
tasks.description: Strip eh- prefix in bin/swarm alias mapping for eh-swarm-debate and eh-swarm-audit; unify package version to 0.3.4 across pyproject.toml, __version__, CLI --version, and MCP info
tasks.details: Addresses Codex Medium-11, Medium-12, and release identity recommendations
